title: ReAgent run event — FROZEN CONTRACT
description:
One row of the `run_events` table. Written by wf/runtime, read by wf/dashboard's trace viewer.

TWO RULES THAT ARE NOT NEGOTIABLE.

1. `payload_redacted` is named that way because redaction happens BEFORE the write, never on read. Nothing raw reaches this table. A secret that reaches the database has already lost the demo, because the trace viewer renders what is stored.

2. `run_events.run_id` carries NO foreign key. `runs` is a hypertable with the composite primary key `(id, started_at)`, because every unique index on a hypertable must contain the partitioning column, so `runs(id)` alone is not a key anything can reference. Do not try to add the constraint; it will be rejected.

Spans are modelled as paired `span_open` and `span_close` events sharing a `span_id`, which is how the waterfall gets its nesting and durations.

seq.description: Monotonic within a run. The trace viewer orders by this, not by ts, because two events can share a timestamp.

action.description: Qualified permission string for a tool call ('github:pulls.comment') or 'agent:<name>' for a sub-agent call. Null for events that are not about an action. NOTE this is the INTERNAL permission string, not the MCP wire name.

allowed.description: For tool_call only. FALSE means the call was refused by the wrap_tool_call middleware because it was outside the resolved permissions. The trace viewer must render a denial distinctly: it is the product working, and demo step 4 depends on it being visible.

payload_redacted.description: Post-redaction detail. Shape depends on `type`; see $defs.

span_id.description: Present on span_open and span_close. Shared between the pair.

parent_span_id.description: Gives the waterfall its indentation. Null at the root.

model_call.description: payload_redacted for type: model_call. Cost comes from OpenRouter's response_metadata['cost'] and arrives only in the FINAL streaming chunk, so one of these is written per COMPLETED call. The budget kill-switch accumulates across these at turn boundaries.

result_summary.description: Never the full result; it may be large and may contain secrets.

resource.description: The specific resource touched, e.g. nmc2/infra, for scope auditing.

redaction_hit.description: payload_redacted for type: redaction_hit. MUST NOT contain the matched text. Record what kind of thing was found and where, never the value.

pattern.description: The rule name, e.g. aws_secret_access_key. NOT the match.

metric.description: A custom counter from spec.observability.metrics. FROZEN D23: these are run_events rows aggregated at read time, because there is no metrics table.
